name: read-fence
description: Stops Claude from opening your skill, rule and plugin folders file by file while you have the fence switched on. Skills still run normally.

configDirs.title: Config folders to fence
configDirs.description: Comma-separated Claude config folders whose skills, rules and plugin cache are fenced, ~ allowed. The first one keeps the on/off switch, so accounts given the same list share it. Empty: this account's folder only.

exempt.title: Folders never fenced
exempt.description: Comma-separated folders that stay readable while the fence is on, ~ allowed.
